The Vision

Gourmet Guru is a feature-rich Android application developed as part of a collaborative software project. The aim of the application is to help users easily discover, organise, and manage recipes while providing tools that simplify meal planning and cooking.

Discovery

Explore over 160+ unique recipes via a custom-built cultural API.

Planning

Advanced weekly scheduling to manage nutrition and prep time.

Utility

Automated shopping lists and built-in cooking timers with push notifications.

Collaborative Dynamics

Gourmet Guru was a multi-disciplinary effort. While I led the system architecture and notification logic, the final product is a testament to shared expertise.

MY CONTRIBUTIONS
Architecture design (MVVM), API integration, Notification systems, Recipe collection logic, and UI polishing.
TEAM CONTRIBUTIONS
Database schema management, user authentication protocols, and initial meal-planning wireframes.
SHARED WORK
System testing, debugging sessions, and final deployment documentation.

Visual Vault

Technical Stack

This project leverages the MVVM architecture to ensure a clean separation of concerns, utilizing Kotlin Coroutines and Firebase for real-time data handling.
